requirements.behavior: Versioned safe project-scoped lifecycle with evidence-bearing readiness

acceptance.given: A Git project with the relevant fixture or real upstream environment
acceptance.then: Install full framework into a clean Git workspace without copying source task state

acceptance.given: A Git project with the relevant fixture or real upstream environment
acceptance.then: Merge entry blocks while retaining project config, other skills and business files

acceptance.given: A Git project with the relevant fixture or real upstream environment
acceptance.then: Second identical install performs zero target file writes

acceptance.given: A Git project with the relevant fixture or real upstream environment
acceptance.then: Update only untouched owned files and preserve project settings

acceptance.given: A Git project with the relevant fixture or real upstream environment
acceptance.then: Modified owned/unowned conflicting files are refused before mutation

acceptance.given: A Git project with the relevant fixture or real upstream environment
acceptance.then: Interrupted writes can be rolled back without overwriting later edits

acceptance.given: A Git project with the relevant fixture or real upstream environment
acceptance.then: Uninstall removes untouched managed files only and preserves task history

acceptance.given: A Git project with the relevant fixture or real upstream environment
acceptance.then: Reject symlink/path escape and concurrent installers

acceptance.given: A Git project with the relevant fixture or real upstream environment
acceptance.then: Doctor distinguishes installation, native compatibility and business readiness

acceptance.given: GitHub-run native jobs and a connector-read receipt bound to the release input hashes
acceptance.when: Verify real job outcomes and validate the captured receipt against current release inputs
acceptance.then: Three real native adapters are staged and verified through packaged CLI
